title: Kanan Jarrus
subtitle: Spectre One
text:
Restore 1
When Played: You may return a non-leader unit that costs 2 or less to its owner's hand. If you control a Command or Aggression unit, you may return a non-leader unit that costs 4 or less instead.
rules:
Abilities that refer to a card’s cost always refer to its printed cost, regardless of modifiers.
Abilities that return a card to hand must choose a card in play unless otherwise specified.
